title: Emitter rejects anchor and alias names that contain '~'
Emitter stops writing after the first of several documents that each start with a tag
body:
When two documents are emitted and each starts with a local tag, the second document is missing from the output and the emitter reports an error.

Repro:
```cpp
YAML::Emitter out;
for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
  out << YAML::BeginDoc << YAML::LocalTag("The_Tag")
      << YAML::BeginSeq << "Some Value" << YAML::EndSeq << YAML::EndDoc;
}
```
Expected output:
```
---
!The_Tag
- Some Value
...
---
!The_Tag
- Some Value
...
```

title: Parsing a tagged literal block scalar goes wrong in some indentations
body:
Some inputs with a tag in front of a literal block scalar (`|`) are parsed wrongly or make the parser fail.

Examples (each should parse without error):
1. `key:
- !!str |
   multiple
   words` is a map `key` whose value is a block sequence holding the string `multiple
words` with tag `tag:yaml.org,2002:str`.
2. `key: !t |
 multiple
 words` is a map `key` whose value is the string `multiple
words` with tag `!t`.
3. `key:
- !t |
 multiple
 words` is a map `key` whose value is a block sequence holding the string `multiple
words` with tag `!t`.

title: Node::SetTag with a verbatim tag or a named tag handle emits the wrong tag
DecodeBase64 mishandles whitespace between the padding characters
body: `YAML::DecodeBase64("TQ= =")` should give the single byte `'M'`, the same as `"TQ=="`, because whitespace in Base64 input is ignored. It returns something else.
